objective: Separate information-budget failure from LayerCake sparse-host acquisition failure using a transformer-path student initialized from the exact v41 shared transformer tensors and trained on the exact V81 data, sampling, seed, schedule, and generation-quality screen.

causal_roles.layercake: V81 is the exact sparse-host acquisition observation: 4/28 with three collapses.
causal_roles.transformer_control: The same v41 shared GPT-2 transformer tensors and tied language head, with every task-cake up projection zeroed so all routed cakes are exact identity functions; classifier and cakes are frozen.
causal_roles.abi: Not tested. V71 data is reused as immutable supervision and the oracle stream remains nonproduction.
causal_roles.integration: Not tested. No receiver packaging or runtime promotion follows from this diagnostic.

authorization_basis.v81_result: 4/28 with three collapses; six parent regressions and zero gains
authorization_basis.reason: V80 and V81 show full-core LayerCake conditioning failure, but neither includes the contractually required same-size transformer student.

control_materialization.task_cake_effect: Every task-cake up projection is exact zero, so all routes are the identity function.
control_materialization.task_classifier: Retained for container compatibility, frozen, and behaviorally irrelevant because all routes are identical.

base_control_screen.purpose: Measure the quality contribution of v41's learned cake path before new training.

matching_limits.classifier_loss_difference: The transformer control has no functional router and therefore uses zero classifier loss; V81 used 0.25.
matching_limits.autonomous_recovery_token_note: Generated recovery prefixes can change response truncation by architecture. Report authoritative realized tokens for both candidates rather than claiming exact replay-token equality before measurement.
matching_limits.performance_claim: This identity-cake container is a quality/acquisition control, not the optimized CPU-transformer speed baseline.

decision_rule: If materialization or CUDA stress fails, preserve the failure and do not train.
If the trained transformer control reaches at least 19/28 with zero collapse while V81 remains 4/28, localize the immediate blocker to LayerCake sparse-host acquisition or cake integration.

If the transformer control also fails the 19/28 zero-collapse target, the current information and conditioning budget is insufficient across both paths; do not label the result a LayerCake-only failure.
If neither passes but the transformer produces a different score, report the paired delta without converting it into a categorical causal claim.
No outcome counts as ABI transfer, open-weight extraction proof, runtime dominance, or a promotable English core.
